report.summary: Reviewed daedalus/providers/__init__.py chunk 1/1: defines ProviderMetadata, provider registry, and public functions; docstring lists four providers but code registers six.
risks: docstring | high | Claims only four providers (claude_cli, deepseek, ollama, codex_cli) but registry has six (including openai_api, anthropic_api). | Update docstring to list all six or add note about placeholders.

available_providers | medium | Calls provider_health() which calls _availability_probe -> get_provider -> may raise ValueError for unknown names; but _PROVIDERS is filtered by implemented, so only implemented names are probed. | Verify that get_provider handles only the four implemented names; otherwise could raise.

get_provider | medium | Only handles four names; if called with 'openai_api' or 'anthropic_api' (implemented=False) it raises ValueError; callers must check implemented first. | Add guard or return a placeholder provider.
todos: Update module docstring to reflect all six registered providers or note placeholders.
Consider adding a fallback for get_provider when called with non-implemented names.

handoff.purpose: Define provider metadata registry and public API for listing, retrieving, and checking provider health.

symbols.name: ProviderMetadata
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass holding metadata about a provider: name, display_name, local, trusted_with_ip, can_write, agentic, requires_key, env_keys, implemented.

symbols.name: _PROVIDERS
symbols.note: dict[str, ProviderMetadata] mapping provider names to their metadata; includes ollama, claude_cli, deepseek, openai_api, anthropic_api, codex_cli.

symbols.name: get_provider
symbols.note: Returns a Provider instance for a given name; raises ValueError for unknown names. Only handles 'claude_cli', 'deepseek', 'ollama', 'codex_cli'.

symbols.name: list_providers
symbols.note: Returns list of dicts from asdict(meta) for all providers in _PROVIDERS.

symbols.name: _configured
symbols.note: Returns True if provider does not require a key, or if any of its env_keys are set in environment.

symbols.name: _availability_probe
symbols.note: Returns (bool, str) indicating if provider is available; returns False with message if not implemented, otherwise calls get_provider(name).available().

symbols.name: provider_health
symbols.note: Returns list of dicts with metadata plus 'configured', 'available', 'last_error' for each provider in _PROVIDERS.

symbols.name: available_providers
symbols.note: Returns dict mapping provider name to bool availability for implemented providers.

observations.what: Module docstring lists only four providers, but _PROVIDERS dict contains six entries.
ProviderMetadata for ollama has can_write=True, contradicting docstring claim 'read-only'.
get_provider only handles four names; openai_api and anthropic_api are not implemented and will raise ValueError.
available_providers filters by implemented=True, so it will only return the four implemented providers.

provider_health calls get_provider for all providers in _PROVIDERS, including non-implemented ones; _availability_probe returns (False, 'provider placeholder; implementation pending') for non-implemented, so no ValueError.
ProviderMetadata for claude_cli has local=False, but docstring says it is the primary and trusted with proprietary IP; local=False suggests it is not local, but docstring doesn't claim it is local.
